tools.name: Chop Lab
tools.description: A music studio in your browser: 16 pads, a step sequencer with patterns up to 128 bars, a song timeline for layering patterns into full tracks, a kit for each pattern, 63 genre kits from boom bap and house to jazz, reggae, country, and metal, a sample chopper, a Screw control that slows and deepens everything, two DJ decks with scratching, recording to WAV, and music packs of seamless MP3 loops.
